doc: Architecture-change timeline (§1). Each generation records what the system believed and where the semantics changed in code. HISTORICAL generations may survive only as evidence/rollback; CURRENT is the intended architecture.

generations.name: GENERIC_BTC_BINARY_FORECASTING
generations.arch: BTC data -> features -> UP/DOWN model -> confidence -> trader
generations.note: predicted integer BTC price at fixed clock slots from Coinbase candles

generations.name: MARKET_RELATIVE_MULTI_MODEL
generations.arch: add market-prob comparison, kb model families, traders, calibration, edge gates, RL, execution experiments

generations.name: EXECUTION_RESEARCH
generations.arch: T0.5 Kalshi repricing predictability; separate settlement prediction from execution; wait-for-dip falsified

generations.name: CONTRACT_MECHANICS_DISCOVERY
generations.arch: target = opening BRTI 60s avg; settlement = closing BRTI 60s avg; YES iff close>=open

generations.name: LABEL_CORRECTION
generations.arch: Coinbase proxy != settlement truth; ~4.5% label divergence; official BRTI outcomes canonical

generations.name: EXACT_BRTI
generations.arch: authenticated live+historical BRTI; reconstruction parity; exact benchmark usable as contract truth

generations.name: CURRENT_INTENDED
generations.arch: Exact BRTI + exact rule -> ContractState -> MECH_FAIR_BRTI -> Independent delta -> Independent Oracle -> Selective Lock -> Kalshi valuation -> T0.5 execution -> Trader -> Paper account -> Exact settlement -> Offline/Online eval -> A/B -> Promotion/Rollback -> HOME+ORACLE
